name: Mary Adams (Swan)
notable_stories: In a common practice of the time, she married her late sister Magdalena's husband to care for her nieces and nephews
milestones: Married Lewis Swan in Franklin County, Ohio (m. 24 Sep 1848)
sources: Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
notes: Siblings listed: Twin brother George Francis (#1), Alexander Washington, Magdalena, Harriet Josephine, Susan, and Ursula
Twin of George; deceased by 1909 per the Gill biography. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 7598]
Twin of George (Francis Adams #1); child of Jose and Elizabeth [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 8313]
